item.title: EU AI Act AI System Definition: The Official 7-Element Test
item.description: The EU AI Act only applies to systems that meet the legal definition of an “AI system” in Article 3(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. Before anyone can talk about risk categories, prohibited practices, or compliance obligations, this is the gateway question: does the tool in front of you actually qualify. This guide walks through the European Commission’s official 7-element test — published as Guidelines on the definition of an AI system, reference C(2025) 5053 final, dated 29 July 2025 — and turns it into a checklist you can run against your own tools.

item.title: The EU AI Act: Everything Digital Creators Need to Know
item.description: Most digital creators I talk to think the EU AI Act means one thing: slap an “AI-generated” tag on your video and move on. It doesn’t. Article 50 is the part with a hard deadline — 2 August 2026 — so it gets all the attention. But it’s one article inside a bigger framework, and creators who only prepare for the label are missing the parts that actually restrict how they can build and use AI tools.
